title: Love this rug!
text: Love this rug!. I had originally ordered the Dallas and then read reviews that said the pile was very low and the rug was not soft. So I decided to order the Hudson after reading reviews that the quality of the rug was great and the pile was high and fluffy. After seeing how both rugs came packaged, it was obvious that the hudson is a much fuller and thicker rug as it was a much bigger package than the dallas. The rug is just like the pictures that are shown in the other reviews. It is very plush about a 2" pile that does not mat down. The rug is soft and comfortable to lay on. I am extremely happy with the quality and the decision to get the hudson rug over the dallas
